acceptance_criteria.criterion: When removed mods are present, the confirmation dialog message includes the count and risk detail for removals (e.g., "1 removed mod — positions shifted, save references may break" or "3 removed mod(s) — positions shifted, save references may break").
When inserted mods are present, the confirmation dialog message includes the count and risk detail for insertions.
When both removed and inserted mods are present, both detail lines appear in the confirmation message.
The overall message uses `ConfirmUpdateMessage_RiskyChanges` as the template with detail lines embedded via `{0}` format placeholder.
When only safe changes are present (added/replaced only), no confirmation dialog is shown and the operation proceeds directly — this preserves the current behavior.
The confirmation dialog title (`ConfirmUpdateTitle`) and icon (`ConfirmationIcon.Warning`) remain unchanged.

summary: Modified UpdateReferenceWithConfirmationAsync() in DiffDialogViewModel.cs to build a risk-aware confirmation message instead of the generic ConfirmUpdateMessage. When removed mods are present, the singular (count == 1 → ConfirmRiskyDetail_RemovedSingular) or plural (count > 1 → string.Format(ConfirmRiskyDetail_Removals, count)) detail line is assembled. Same pattern for inserted mods via ConfirmRiskyDetail_InsertedSingular / ConfirmRiskyDetail_Insertions. Both detail lines are joined with '\n' into a detail block, then embedded into ConfirmUpdateMessage_RiskyChanges via string.Format({0}). The ConfirmationRequestedEventArgs now receives this composed message. ConfirmUpdateTitle and ConfirmationIcon.Warning remain unchanged. Safe-only paths (added/replaced mods only) do not enter the if-block at all, preserving the existing behavior of skipping the dialog entirely. Build: 0 errors, 0 warnings. 492/494 tests pass; 2 are intentionally skipped stubs (ConfirmationMessage_RiskyChanges_IncludesRemovedCount, ConfirmationMessage_SafeChanges_SkipsDialog) that document a known test-environment barrier for this method.
